authoring: Five whole source-backed32 humanoid families: direct authorized WORLD illustration import plus declared native limb/sleep edits. Original sources and v19 packets preserved. Every source conversion is explicitly lossy; no native-grid recovery or old16 enlargement is claimed.

shaman.identity: Brown topknot orc Shaman, pointed ears, green face with ivory eyes/tusks, leather crossed vest, wrist/shoulder bindings, steel mace, wooden shield and separated boots.
shaman.source_note: The generated image is new authorized design artwork, not an old native pixel grid. All four complete figures preserve source aspect ratio and alpha threshold128, sampled once directly at32 with NEAREST, then semantic per8x8 material fitting.
shaman.resampling: Single direct large-source→native32 NEAREST for stills; no16px source involved. No smoothing, no whole-body or raster animation resampling.
shaman.animation_note: Opposing native leg/boot keys redraw only rows27–31. Upper27rows including head/hair/face/torso/forearms/hands/equipment exactly match the still. Each complete pose remains within its still13tile mask.

provenance.sampling: NEAREST, aspect-preserving whole figure fit32, bottom anchored
provenance.material_policy: Source-brown hair/leather is recognized by hue even in shadows; genuine dark non-brown contours remain ink. Source ivory eyes/tusks force face palette6; skin uses2/6, leather2/3, steel5. No additional silhouette pixels created during still conversion.
provenance.approved_native_fit_variant: ivory (brown materials preserved, face whites protected)

base.identity: Unclassed Peon with brown topknot, pointed ears, green face with actual source ivory eyes/tusks, leather crossed vest and wrist bindings, open hands and separated boots.
base.source_note: New authorized whole WORLD design sampled directly32, not enlarged16 or recovered native grid. Source-face ivory components are explicitly retained in supported native cells before palette conversion.
base.resampling: Single large-source→32 NEAREST still fit, with actual source-face ivory landmark retention. Animation uses exact native-cell placements only; no resampling or full-body bob.
base.animation_note: Two opposed boot/ankle keys authored on the native32 grid. Each key moves only the declared existing boot cells by one native row, preserving cuffs/toes/contours; face/hair/torso/hands/equipment remain identical. Warlock robe folds are protected through row28; only the visible boots move.

provenance.background_policy: Use provided source alpha128. Low-alpha painted gradient/glow outside each complete figure is discarded; no RGB chromakey, edge flood fill or arbitrary body erasure.
provenance.still_geometry: Whole alpha component, aspect-preserving direct32 NEAREST, centered and bottom anchored. Alpha unchanged by material conversion and face landmark retention.
provenance.material_policy: Brown shadows retain warm hair/leather, dark source contours retain ink. Source ivory eyes/tusks reserve palette6. Purple garment clusters retain1; warm trim becomes olive. Native three-opaque-color per8x8 constraints can approximate mixed red/steel/skin shoulder tiles with brown/ivory.

sleeping.animation_note: Two native opposed boot keys preserve the closed-eyes sleeping upper body; these reserved movement slots remain coherent if the NPC is moved. The usual sleeping NPC uses its standing still.
